newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocx mixed, Kras forges ahead.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocx mixed, Kras forges ahead.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed in modest trade on Friday with mild losses among hoteliers and chocolate maker Kras forging ahead.
* Of 12 active traded stocks six rose, four fell and two were unchanged.
* Turnover lower at 2.9 million kuna, volume also halved at 7,327 shares.
* Biggest gainer was confectioner Kras which rose 28 kuna to 525 on volume of 1,597 shares.
* Leading decliner was cable maker Elka which lost five kuna to 170 trading 478 units.
* Most actively traded stock was food company Podravka with 2.236 units changing hands. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
